October. 7, _ 1918, Fixing Prices at the Mirie for Bituminous Coal mined by Monievallo

revision of the prices of bituminous coal mined by Montevallo Mining Company, in the

Buch application, acting under authority of an Executive Order of the President of

subsequent Executive Orders, and in furtherance of the purpose of said orders and
of the Act of Congress therein referred to and approved August 10, 1917,
Sbkeby orders and directs, that bituminous coal mined by Montevallo Mining
Company, in the State of Alabama, may be sold at prices f . o. b. cars at the mine, not

United States Fuel Administrator.
Washington, D. C, October 4, 1918.
